description: This Java class 'UnsafeSorterSpillWriter' handles spilling sorted records to disk in Apache Spark, managing buffer writing, file creation, and serialization details.

classes.name: UnsafeSorterSpillWriter
classes.description: Handles writing sorted records to disk with buffer management and serialization.

methods.name: writeLongToBuffer
methods.description: Serializes a long value into a byte buffer at a specified offset.

methods.name: writeIntToBuffer
methods.description: Serializes an int value into a byte buffer at a specified offset.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a record to the spill file, including prefix and length, managing buffer transfer.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the writer and releases resources.

methods.name: getReader
methods.description: Creates a reader for the spill file.

methods.name: recordsSpilled
methods.description: Returns the number of records spilled.
